name: inline-presentation
description: Detects when an assistant response contains structured or relational data (process, relational, hierarchical, time-series, comparative, key-value, numeric/proportion, set/categorical) and renders it inline using a fixed catalog of CLI-friendly forms (ASCII flowcharts, tree views, ER-style diagrams, Gantt bars, side-by-side cards, two-column tables, horizontal bars, cluster cards). Operates by default — anticipates the right visual form so the user does not have to ask 'can you make this visual?'. No Mermaid, no LaTeX, no color conventions — purely structural.
